title: LESSON 1 - BEGINNER BHANGRA SERIES | Fundamentals & Bhangra Footwork | BFUNK Dance Tutorials

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers break down fundamental Bhangra footwork step by step with clear verbal explanations and physical demonstrations. They emphasize posture, weight shifting, and tempo progression while maintaining an encouraging and upbeat tone.

lesson_structure.note: The two instructors introduce the beginner Bhangra series and lesson one.
Demonstration of the Bhangra footwork to music.
Explanation of fundamental footwork posture and learning the Bedi step.
Breakdown and explanation of the second footwork step, Dhamaal.

cues: Shift your weight onto your right leg
metaphors: It looks a little bit of a pendulum effect
common_mistakes: Slams foot down with the entire foot, which can hurt the shin
Leaving too much space in between feet during the Dhamaal step
safety: Do not slam your whole foot down to avoid injury
Stretch your hip flexors to increase range

steps_taught.name: Bedi
steps_taught.description: A tapping motion shifting weight between legs while staying on the balls of the feet.

steps_taught.name: Dhamaal
steps_taught.description: A hop type motion lifting and flexing the leg with a pendulum effect.

what_works: Clear visual demonstration alongside verbal instructions
Breaking down movements at a slower count before picking up the tempo
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between detailed explanations and full-speed demonstrations

quotes.text: The first thing in Bhangra, you always want to focus on having an unlocked knee.
If she puts a lot of pressure and slams that foot down with the entire foot, it's really going to hurt her shin.
She's using the energy here from her left hip that strength from the left hip to lift this up.
I think the biggest mistake that we make here when we're doing this move is we lift it up and then we leave too much space in between our feet.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing front with hands on hips, explaining knee posture and weight placement while another instructor stands behind in mirror view.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact muscular tension and subtle weight distribution

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher crouches down pointing at the other instructor's foot to highlight proper ball-of-foot placement versus full-foot landing.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact downward force exerted by the foot

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a two-person setup where one instructor speaks and guides while the other demonstrates alongside in a mirrored position.
